address: Sandy Cove Hotel, Old Coast Road, Combe Martin, Berrynarbor, EX34 9SR, United Kingdom
bio: The family-run Sandy Cove Hotel is the home for this long-standing, intimate restaurant which comes with a jewel of a terrace and commanding views of the bay. The colourful, modern dishes make use of quality seasonal ingredients, with a focus on local seafood – the mussel-stuffed sea bream shows the kitchen at its best, displaying technical precision and a good balance of flavours and textures. The cooking comes in the form of a six-course tasting menu – with wine pairings available – and the service is warm and friendly....
